name: Step on Me I'll Crush You All
description: When Sky Group chair Mona Lane's daughter is nearly killed by drunk driver Harry Stone, his mother, Sue Mack, offers Mona two million dollars to keep quiet. Then Mona recognizes the black card Sue flashes. It's the one she gave her husband, Evan Stone. For nearly twenty years, Evan has used Mona's money to support Sue and their son. Sue expects a grieving mother she can buy. Instead, she's exposed everything to the one woman she never should have crossed.

name: The Dragon King's Four Little Heirs
description: Five years ago, Nora saved the Dragon King, Aiden, and secretly gave birth to their quadruplets. Forced into hiding to protect her children, she vanishes without a trace. When their identities are exposed, Nora and the children are hunted and betrayed. Reunited with Aiden, she faces jealous nobles and deadly enemies—until her ancient dragon bloodline awakens, changing the fate of her family forever.

name: The Clerk They Mocked Was a Legendary Spy
description: He was the CIA's only agent named Zero. Then he became a school social worker—mocked, ignored, called a coward. When the mafia kidnapped his daughter, they thought they were untouchable. They didn't know who they'd provoked. One man. One gun. An entire crime family in his path. But the worst is yet to come—because someone far more dangerous is already hunting him.

name: Move Aside, I'm the True Dragon Awakener
description: Celine, the legendary Dragon Awakener, hides her identity to find her missing dragon. But when a servant's daughter steals her name and claims her power, Celine is mocked as a nobody. As the Dragon Trials begin and sparks fly with her fiancé Ellis, how long can she stay hidden before the dragons reveal the truth?

name: Island Game: My CEO's Obsession
description: Noah is a male Omega, and nobody knows. To clear his father's debt he sells one night on a private island in a wig and a mask, and wakes the wrong Alpha—Hawk Lawrence, his new boss. A swapped wristband sends Hawk after an impostor while Noah hides a pregnancy and his parents put a price on him. He has been sold his whole life. One man refuses to buy.

name: Her Secret Lycan King
description: Lyra is about to be exiled for her "cursed" wolf unless she finds a legal mate overnight. The mysterious man she rescued agrees to marry her. Their fake marriage becomes real—and she slowly realizes her omega husband is the missing Alpha King, Caius.

name: The Magicless Archmage and the Iron Grail
description: Born without magic, Kyle works as a servant at Frosthaven Academy, enduring humiliation to support his younger siblings. When a mysterious Iron Grail awakens his hidden powers, he enters a deadly magic tournament to save his family. With the gifted ice mage Elara by his side, Kyle uncovers his legendary bloodline and a terrifying conspiracy. As an ancient Dark Lord rises, the boy once mocked as worthless may become the world's last hope.

name: Escaped from Eight Alphas, Sold Back by My Mate
description: Five years ago, Elara fled the eight Northern Alphas who claimed she was their shared fated mate. She saved Kyle, chose him instead, and helped him become Alpha—only for him to betray her for his pregnant mistress and sell her back to the men she escaped. Kyle thinks he is sacrificing a powerless mate to save his pack. He has no idea all eight Alphas have spent five years waiting for Elara—and what they will do when they see her scars.

name: The Queen Behind His Throne
description: For five years, Erin sacrificed everything to build her husband Marcus's mafia empire. But after he humiliates her for his new assistant and mistress, she withdraws $68 million and leaves with their son. Within three days, his empire begins to collapse. Only then does Marcus realize his wife was the true power behind his throne.

name: Mask Off
description: Nova Reyes is a broke scholarship freshman by day and Vesper, a masked candidate fighting for the last open seat on the Vanguard, by night. Cole Sterling is her insufferable TA and her best friend's brother — and, unknown to her, he's also competing under the mask of Raze, the golden boy everyone assumes will win by birthright alone. Neither has any idea the rival they're falling for in secret is the person they can't stand in daylight. As missions pull them closer and the truth gets harder to hide, Nova has to decide whether winning the seat that could finally save her family is worth losing the one person who's ever seen her — mask on or off.

name: The Mermaid Princess's Pirate King Husband
description: Mermaid Princess Serena escapes her abusive ex, Julian, and agrees to a contract marriage with Pirate King Roderick to care for his daughter, Mira. As trust and love heal her wounds, Julian's pursuit brings ruin upon the Hawk family. Free at last, Serena accepts Roderick's love and begins a new life at sea with him, Mira, and their unborn child.

name: Love Me or Lose Everything
description:
Leon, the heir to an old-money family, tests Jane's love—and ruins her life. Her father works himself to death to pay for Leon's surgery. Her mother kills herself for the insurance money, hoping it will save Jane from carrying the burden alone.

Now Jane has lost everything. So what does a girl from the slums do when the man she loved destroys her entire family?

name: My Cursed Merman Husband Rules the Deep
description:
The disabled Duke Vance is rumored to be a monster. It's also rumored that each of his seven previous brides died on their wedding night. Chloe, desperate to escape being sold off by her own father and half-sister, makes a big gamble: She signs the marriage contract in blood and becomes the Duke's eighth wife.
Everyone expects Chloe to end up as another cold corpse. Instead, Chloe survives and gradually earns the Duke's trust and love. But the man the world dismisses as a useless cripple is hiding an extraordinary secret: Duke Vance is actually the King of the Merfolk, ruler of the deep sea.

name: Craving The Wrong Brother
description: Sloane has loved her best friend Finn for ten years, always there when his toxic girlfriend breaks him. When Finn asks her to crash his ex's wedding, she meets his dangerous older brother Knox, who sees through her—and starts a twisted bet that turns into something deeper. Now she's torn between the brother who always broke her heart and the one determined to claim it.

name: Pay Me Or Lose Me
description: Mika, Chloe's ghost-singer, died taking a bullet for her—reborn, she knows she was just a pawn. A succubus system drains coins from top men to heal her scars, restore her looks, survive. Athlete Luke craves her pheromones; she treats him as her ATM. Chloe frames her; Mika exposes her, saves heir Thorne. Reborn a beauty, she crushes the traitors.

name: Every Night with the Hockey Star in My Dreams
description: Med student Lyla has a bizarre gift: think of someone before sleep and she falls straight into their dream. She meant to reach campus heartthrob Ethan Moore, but keeps landing in the bed of Hayden Cole, the hockey star everyone is terrified of — and just as he asks to meet her in real life, she is assigned as the team's new medical assistant, face to face with the man from her dreams.

name: Death Game: Don't Tell Her He's the King
description: In 2048, broke student Elena enters a deadly game to pay for her mother's treatment. When a rich rival steals her A-rank contract orb, she is stuck with Lucian, a supposedly useless F-rank ghost. But he is secretly the King of the Shadow Realm. As monsters hunt Elena, the entire game is about to learn what happens when its ruler falls in love.

name: The Return of the Mech Goddess: Storm's Awakening
description: Charlotte, the Federation's only SSS-class mecha ace Storm, retired to honor her mother's dying wish. She sold everything and bled herself dry to make her fiancé Blake a B-class pilot. At his promotion banquet, Blake dumps her and proposes to heiress Grace. Then General Karl descends from the sky: she is my wife.

name: Live for Us, Alexander the Great
description: In 323 BC, a U.S. military doctor saves Alexander the Great. Over 2,000 years later, a higher-dimensional invasion threatens humanity. A united world sends 180 experts into the past to teach medicine, farming, gunpowder and steelmaking. Facing a plot against his throne, Alexander must turn their sacrifices into time for humanity to survive.

name: My Alpha Killed Me, So I Let His Lover Die
description: After her Alpha mate murders her and their unborn pup for his first love, Moon Healer Sansa is reborn at the moment everything began. This time, she refuses to save Consort Cynthia and turns the royal court into her battlefield. As Alpha Ares watches his lover’s lies unravel, Sansa rises from betrayed Luna to the destined mate of the Lycan Prince—and makes everyone who destroyed her pay in blood.

name: The Luna He Gave Away
description: Given away by the arrogant Alpha King Kaelan to his outcast half-brother Eric, Leah expects a life of exile. Instead, they instantly recognize each other as fated mates! Eric braves deadly blizzards to heal Leah's scarred eyes, proving his absolute devotion. But Leah is no ordinary Omega—she carries the ancient, supreme Holy Light bloodline. Their ultimate union awakens her legendary power and Eric's dormant royal strength, transforming them into the ultimate rulers.

name: Marrying My Ex's Mafia Brother
description: Talented dancer Sylvia performs a birthday solo for Aston after three years together, only to watch him announce his engagement to Veronica. She breaks up with him and kisses his younger brother Grant, who has mafia ties. She won't promise love again; he wants her forever. Her ex's obsession and rivals’ schemes deepen their dangerous affair. When Aston begs her to come back with a ring, she is already his brother’s wife. This time, Sylvia chooses her own love and reclaims her stage.

name: The Oracle's Awakening: My Ex-Husband Begs for Mercy
description: Chandler, the arrogant Sun God, discards his wife Tracy, unknowingly destroying the realm she sustained as the legendary Origin Rune Master "Z." Cursed and dying, she's rescued by Sean, the terrifying Lord of the Abyss, who has hunted her for a century. As monsters invade and the realm collapses, Tracy unleashes her true power, crushes her enemies, and ascends as the Supreme Goddess-Queen.

name: Claimed by Seven Immortal Kings
description: In Nocturne City, night-shift cleaner Ayla fuses with an ancient blood jade, awakening the Abyss Law—and seven immortal overlords sense their lost queen. As tycoon Victor kidnaps her mother to seize the jade, Ayla awakens her bloodline, tames all seven lords, crushes Victor with the united jade, and crowns herself the sole Night Queen.

name: One Dollar, One Chance, One Family Saved
description: Reborn at eight, former anti-gambling ambassador Ian vows to rewrite his family's tragic fate. Armed with a single coin, he storms underground casinos, exposing every cheating trick. Battling casinos, waking a lost rich heir, and outsmarting villains, he gathers evidence and helps police crush the illegal gambling ring.

name: The Coffin at the Insurance Gate
description: After his mother's death, Ethan's insurance claim is endlessly stalled by a giant company's vague clauses. Out of options, he wheels her coffin to the insurer's doorstep, drawing media attention. Claims agent Clara discovers systemic denial. Together they fight corporate injustice—not with violence, but with truth.

name: The Mighty Wolf Baby Has an Alpha Daddy
description: Five-year-old Luna travels to Detroit to find her father, Adrian, the Alpha of Moon Ridge Manor. Armed with half a crescent pendant and hidden supernatural strength, she uncovers a deadly conspiracy led by the traitorous Viktor. Initially rejected by her

name: The Alpha's Secret Twins
